summary.intent: Plan and validate Phase 21 (BYO IPFS node support) implementation across 6 plans in 4 waves, then iterate on identified issues.
summary.outcome: Plans were checked, 5 blockers and 3 warnings identified, and a revision loop was initiated to fix violations of locked architectural decisions (no server relay, zero-knowledge constraints, fail-fast behavior).

repo: Phase 21 covers BYO IPFS node support with locked decisions: no server relay for external-only mode, fail with clear error when external node unreachable, zero-knowledge constraint prohibits server-side BYO config storage in vaults table
Planning structure lives in .planning/phases/21-byo-ipfs-node-support/ with per-plan files and a VALIDATION.md
A GSD planner/checker/reviser loop is in use with up to 3 revision iterations

code.finding: Task 2 had two blockers: 'minimal integration' override always uploaded to CipherBox first (violates no-server-relay decision) and silent fallback to CipherBox when external node unreachable (violates fail-with-clear-error decision)
Task 1 stored BYO config server-side in vaults table, violating zero-knowledge constraint; also missing wiring from StorageTab save handler to migration API
Scope flagged as too broad; client-side ECIES encryption of provider configs for TEE migration was never specified
Missing wiring from StorageTab save handler to migration API start; ECIES encryption for TEE migration unspecified
Plan mapping errors flagged as warnings by checker

workflow: The planner/checker/reviser pattern catches architectural constraint violations before implementation begins
Locked decisions must be explicitly cross-referenced in plans; silent fallbacks and convenience overrides are common sources of violations
Wave-based planning can produce Nyquist-style sampling gaps — Wave 3 had one flagged

friction: 5 blockers required a full revision loop iteration before plans could proceed
ECIES encryption requirement for TEE migration was never specified in any of Plans 04/05/06, indicating a gap in upstream requirements
VALIDATION.md had plan mapping errors, suggesting the validation scaffold was not kept in sync with plan changes
open_items: Client-side ECIES encryption of provider configs for TEE migration needs to be specified and added to Plans 04/05/06
StorageTab save handler → migration API wiring needs explicit implementation steps in Plans 04 and 06
Wave 3 Nyquist sampling gap warning needs resolution
Plan 05 scope breadth warning may require splitting or descoping
Revision loop has 2 iterations remaining (1/3 used); further checker runs may surface additional issues
